Vendored copies so the app does not depend on a CDN:
- audio_bundle.mjs, audio_wasm_internal.js/.wasm: @mediapipe/tasks-audio 1.2.3 from npm (Apache-2.0, Google).
- yamnet.tflite: MediaPipe YAMNet audio classifier model, from
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/audio_classifier/yamnet/float32/1/yamnet.tflite
